newsitem.title: USA: Fernandez-Argentine economy exiting from recession.
newsitem.headline: Fernandez-Argentine economy exiting from recession.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said Sunday his country's economy was emerging from recession, and reiterated a projection for 5.0 percent GDP growth in 1997.
"There is no doubt the economy is moving at a very good pace out of the recession," Fernandez told a conference sponsored by the Institute for International Finance here.
He said that Argentina projected a 5.0 percent forecast of GDP growth for 1997 in its Letter of Intent to the International Monetary Fund.
He also said the Argentine financial sector was in good shape. "The financial sector in Argentina is growing at a very good pace."
